name: Markdown blocks
description:
**Summary**

- Goal: make fenced markdown blocks render as code blocks instead of being re-rendered as formatted markdown.
- Root cause: `parseBlocks` only assigned a synthetic `fileName` to non-markdown fences, so `ChapterBlock.isCodeBlock` (`!!fileName`) stayed false for `md`/`markdown`/`text`.
- Fix: added `currentIsFence` tracking in `src/utils/markdownParser.js` and generate `fileName` for any fenced block.
- Result: ` ```md `, ` ```markdown `, ` ```text ` route through `<Code>` with copy/edit affordances; plain prose keeps markdown rendering.
- Deliberately avoided forcing unfenced prose into code blocks to preserve document readability and formatting.
- Only one file changed; no edits to `Document.vue` or `ChapterBlock.vue` were required.
